title: Announcing the Public Beta of the New Odigos UI
summary: Announcing the public beta of the new Odigos UI! Discover our redesigned, user-friendly interface, packed with powerful features and interactive visualizations to enhance your observability experience. Join the beta to explore the new UI and shape its future with your feedback.
